question: By what percentage did AMD's Data Center segment revenue grow year over year in Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 27, 2026 versus the quarter ended June 28, 2025)? Compute it from the reported segment revenue figures.
grading: 107.35% ±0.3pp; the company's own rounded 107% is also accepted. Inputs: Data Center segment revenue USD 6,718M (Q2 2026) and USD 3,240M (Q2 2025). Fail if total-company, sequential or six-month growth is given.
answer: Data Center segment revenue was USD 6,718 million in Q2 2026 versus USD 3,240 million in Q2 2025, so growth = 6,718 / 3,240 - 1 = 107.35% (AMD's release rounds this to 107%). [T06-E1, T06-E2]

output.answer:
**AMD Data Center segment revenue grew ~107% year over year in Q2 2026.**

Computation from reported segment figures:
- Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 27, 2026): **$6.72 billion** (often stated as $6.7B)
- Q2 2025 (quarter ended June 28, 2025): **$3.24 billion** (often stated as $3.2B)

Growth = (6.72 − 3.24) / 3.24 = 3.48 / 3.24 ≈ **1.074 = +107.4%**

AMD itself reported this as "up 107% year-over-year" to a record $6.7 billion, driven by EPYC processors and Instinct GPUs; Data Center reached 58% of total revenue (up from 42% a year earlier).

Sources:
- AMD IR press release: https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1295/amd-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results
- AMD Newsroom: https://newsroom.amd.com/news/amd-2q-2026-earnings
- CNBC: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/amd-earnings-report-q2-2026.html
- Yahoo Finance (figures $6.72B vs $3.24B): https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/advanced-micro-devices-shares-fall-112121820.html
